name: codex-proofline
description: Connect acceptance criteria to command, file, screenshot, environment, and timestamp evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Turn done into a checkable proof graph
interface.longDescription: Map each acceptance criterion to fresh, observed command, file, screenshot, environment, and timestamp evidence; surface gaps before a PR or release.
defaultPrompt: Build a Proofline graph for this project's acceptance criteria.
Check whether this release is actually supported by fresh evidence.
Generate a Proofline report for my pull request.
Show which evidence became stale after this acceptance contract changed.
